feature: Install onboarding, the first-run checklist's fallback row (handoff design_handoff_the99_install_onboarding, R1c, frames F1, F1s, F2; PR 3 of 3)
note: Signed in as the dedicated first-run account (`E2E_AUDIT_USER_EMAIL=onboard-probe+clerk_test@the99.app`, no cards, no decks): Home is the checklist. Its tour may be due; the first step waits past its arrival and presses Escape, which skips a tour that opened and does nothing otherwise, so every row is a player who left the tour before its Install stop. The `iphone-safari` and `android` widths carry a phone user agent; the row draws only where the header slot would (Android needs a held `beforeinstallprompt`, which headless Chromium does not fire, so `android` photographs no row: the B4/F1 Android line is held by install-row.test.tsx). `phone` (a desktop agent at 390) and `desktop` are the no-row frames. Each run's browser starts with no local mark and no dismissal.
